column1: # Reader-facing short book names (KJV) and command-box abbreviations.
# App data, not content: it is the machine-readable table of the biblical
# scholar's cited recommendation, copied byte for byte (every line below this
# A test (app/src-tauri/src/books.rs) checks the copy against that file.
# Citation (kjv-book-names.md section 8): short names from The Holy Bible
# (Oxford: Clarendon Press, Samuel Collingwood and Co., 1823), "The Names and
# Order of all the Books", unpaginated front matter, University of Toronto copy,
# 2026-10-22; cross-checked against The Holy Bible, Red Letter Edition,
# Authorized King James Version (Oxford: University Press, printed for Concordia
# Abbreviations: The SBL Handbook of Style, 2nd ed. (SBL Press, 2014), section
# 8.3, as given by University of Divinity Library, "Style guide: Bible"; the
# others are UX convention, not content. Per the scholar: `jud` removed from
# Jude (ambiguous with Judges), `cant` added to Song of Solomon.
# Short names use option A (arabic numerals, "1 Samuel"); the editions print
# roman numerals ("I. Samuel"). Owner decision pending: see NUMERALS in books.rs.
# Columns: osis, short_name, citation, abbreviations (comma-separated, lower
# case, no spaces; the full name always matches too). Tab-separated, UTF-8.
